import os,sys,json,hashlib,traceback,inspect
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
A=Path('artifacts/answerability_semantic_v2_1_direct_regex_decoder')
p=A/'STRUCTURAL_RESULTS.json';d=json.loads(p.read_bytes())
assert d['status']=='TEXTUAL_PASS_FSM_PENDING'
env_path=A/'ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT.json';env=json.loads(env_path.read_bytes())
assert env['post_install']['integrity']=='PASS' and env['import_api']['status']=='PASS'
freeze=json.loads((A/'REGEX_FREEZE_RECEIPT.json').read_bytes())
for n,h in freeze['freeze_hashes'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,n
os.environ.update(HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1',HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY='1',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',OUTLINES_CACHE_DIR=str(Path('.cache/phase2h-direct-regex-runtime').resolve()))
events=[]
def guard(event,args):
 if event.startswith('socket.'):
  events.append({'event':event,'args':str(args)})
  if event in {'socket.connect','socket.getaddrinfo','socket.gethostbyname','socket.gethostbyaddr','socket.sendto'}:raise RuntimeError('Offline FSM qualification forbids network operation: '+event)
  if event=='socket.bind' and str(args[1][0]) not in {'::1','127.0.0.1'}:raise RuntimeError('Non-loopback bind')
 if event=='open' and isinstance(args[0],str) and args[0].lower().endswith(('.safetensors','pytorch_model.bin')):raise RuntimeError('Model weight access forbidden')
sys.addaudithook(guard)
fsm={'started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'STARTED','rows':[],'outlines_import_attempts':0,'outlines_core_import_attempts':0,'tokenizer_loads':0,'regex_compilations_attempted':0,'logits_processor_constructions':0,'model_initialization':0,'forward':0,'generate':0,'fixture_executions':0,'runner_source':runner_source,'runner_sha256':hashlib.sha256(runner_source.encode()).hexdigest(),'construction_scope':'Tokenizer-only construction of the official OutlinesCoreBackend vocabulary and direct-regex processor; no Transformers model-wrapper constructor or model call. Backend __init__ model branch is replaced solely by its tokenizer-derived fields.'}
d['FSM']=fsm
def checkpoint():
 fsm['socket_events']=events
 p.write_bytes((json.dumps(d,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
checkpoint()
try:
 fsm['outlines_import_attempts']+=1
 import outlines
 fsm['outlines_core_import_attempts']+=1
 from outlines_core import Guide
 from outlines.backends.outlines_core import OutlinesCoreBackend
 from outlines.models.transformers import TransformerTokenizer
 import outlines.backends.outlines_core as backend_module
 def forbidden_schema(*args,**kwargs):raise RuntimeError('JSON Schema compiler path forbidden')
 backend_module.build_regex_from_schema=forbidden_schema
 from transformers import AutoTokenizer
 identity=json.loads(Path('artifacts/answerability_semantic_runtime_v1_enablement/MODEL_SNAPSHOT_IDENTITY.json').read_bytes())
 snapshot=Path(identity['snapshot_path'])
 revision='989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306'
 assert identity['immutable_revision']==revision and snapshot.name==revision
 inventory=json.loads(Path('artifacts/answerability_semantic_runtime_v1_enablement/MODEL_FILE_INVENTORY.json').read_bytes())
 names={'config.json','tokenizer.json','tokenizer_config.json','merges.txt','vocab.json'}
 hashes={}
 for item in inventory['files']:
  if item['relative_path'] in names:
   actual=hashlib.sha256((snapshot/item['relative_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
   assert actual==item['sha256'],item['relative_path']
   hashes[item['relative_path']]=actual
 assert set(hashes)==names
 fsm['tokenizer_identity']={'model':identity['repository'],'revision':revision,'snapshot_path':str(snapshot),'files_sha256':hashes,'local_files_only':True,'trust_remote_code':False}
 fsm['tokenizer_loads']+=1;checkpoint()
 tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(snapshot),revision=revision,local_files_only=True,trust_remote_code=False,use_fast=True)
 wrapped=TransformerTokenizer(tok)
 vocabulary=OutlinesCoreBackend.create_outlines_core_vocabulary(wrapped.get_vocab(),wrapped.eos_token_id,wrapped.eos_token,wrapped.convert_token_to_string)
 backend=object.__new__(OutlinesCoreBackend)
 backend.vocabulary=vocabulary;backend.eos_token_id=wrapped.eos_token_id;backend.tensor_library_name='torch'
 fsm['vocabulary_size']=len(wrapped.get_vocab());fsm['eos_token_id']=wrapped.eos_token_id
 fsm['regex_compilations_attempted']+=1;checkpoint()
 processor=backend.get_regex_logits_processor((A/'DECODER_ENFORCEMENT_REGEX.txt').read_text())
 fsm['logits_processor_constructions']+=1
 index=processor.index
 fsm['final_state_count']=len(index.get_final_states())
 checkpoint()
 fixtures=json.loads((A/'STRUCTURAL_FIXTURES.json').read_bytes())['fixtures']
 textrows={r['id']:r for r in d['textual']}
 for fixture in fixtures:
  row={'id':fixture['id'],'expected':fixture['expected'],'regex':textrows[fixture['id']]['regex'],'tokenization':None,'traversal':None,'EOS':None,'result':'STARTED'}
  fsm['fixture_executions']+=1
  try:
   ids=tok.encode(fixture['text'],add_special_tokens=False)
   roundtrip=tok.decode(ids,skip_special_tokens=False,clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False)
   row['tokenization']={'token_ids':ids,'count':len(ids),'roundtrip_exact':roundtrip==fixture['text']}
   if roundtrip!=fixture['text']:raise RuntimeError('Tokenizer text roundtrip mismatch')
   guide=Guide(index);reject=None
   for position,token_id in enumerate(ids):
    if token_id not in guide.get_tokens():
     reject={'position':position,'token_id':token_id,'state':guide.get_state()};break
    guide.advance(token_id=token_id,return_tokens=False)
   if reject is not None:
    row.update(traversal='REJECT',rejection=reject,EOS='NOT_REACHED',final_state=guide.is_finished(),result='REJECT')
   else:
    final=guide.is_finished();eos_allowed=wrapped.eos_token_id in guide.get_tokens()
    row.update(traversal='COMPLETE',EOS='ALLOWED' if eos_allowed else 'NOT_ALLOWED',final_state=final,result='ACCEPT' if final and eos_allowed else 'REJECT')
    if final and eos_allowed:
     guide.advance(token_id=wrapped.eos_token_id,return_tokens=False)
     row['after_eos_final_state']=guide.is_finished()
   row['matches_expectation']=row['result']==fixture['expected']
  except Exception as exc:
   row.update(result='ERROR',error=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc),traceback=traceback.format_exc(),matches_expectation=False)
  fsm['rows'].append(row);checkpoint()
 fsm['matches']=sum(r['matches_expectation'] for r in fsm['rows'])
 fsm['errors']=sum(r['result']=='ERROR' for r in fsm['rows'])
 fsm['false_accepts']=sum(r['expected']=='REJECT' and r['result']=='ACCEPT' for r in fsm['rows'])
 fsm['false_rejects']=sum(r['expected']=='ACCEPT' and r['result']=='REJECT' for r in fsm['rows'])
 fsm['status']='PASS' if fsm['matches']==len(fixtures) else 'FAIL'
 d['status']='STRUCTURAL_PASS' if fsm['status']=='PASS' else 'STRUCTURAL_FAILED'
except Exception as exc:
 fsm.update(status='ERROR',error=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 d['status']='STRUCTURAL_ERROR'
finally:
 fsm['finished_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();checkpoint()
 u={'textual':[r for r in d['textual'] if r['id'].startswith('STRING_')],'FSM':[r for r in fsm['rows'] if r['id'].startswith('STRING_')],'FSM_status':fsm['status'],'schema_validator_executed':False,'contract_validator_scope':'Only frozen 18 neutral contract predicates'}
 (A/'UNICODE_REGRESSION_RESULT.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(u,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
 print('FSM',fsm['status'],'fixtures',fsm['fixture_executions'],'matches',fsm.get('matches'),'errors',fsm.get('errors'),'false_accepts',fsm.get('false_accepts'),'false_rejects',fsm.get('false_rejects'))
 if fsm.get('error'):print(fsm['traceback'])
 for row in fsm['rows']:
  if not row['matches_expectation']:print(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=True))
